summary: Edgemode, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing a non-binding term sheet with Pure Data Centres Group Limited to sell its equity interests in entities holding leasehold land sites in Cordoba, Palma, Vianos and Caceres, Spain, for data center development. No price, stake size, or premium was disclosed. The term sheet is non-binding, subject to purchaser due diligence and definitive documentation. Edgemode granted a 60-day exclusivity period. The registrant is the seller. The structure involves a share purchase agreement with an option for a joint venture. What to watch: completion of due diligence and execution of definitive agreements; no definitive deal until then.
